msg: This CockroachDB image falls under the CockroachDB Software License (from 24.3.0 on 2024-11-18, and 23.1-24.2 patches released from that date): a cluster without a key gets a 7-day grace, then is throttled to 5 concurrent open SQL transactions. Enterprise Free covers only businesses under $10M annual revenue
fix: plan the YugabyteDB cut-over before the next upgrade, or budget the Enterprise licence

msg: Licence key in a migration file: under the CockroachDB Software License the key is renewed yearly (Enterprise Free) and a keyless cluster is throttled after a 7-day grace
fix: YugabyteDB is Apache-2.0, delete the statement on the YSQL side

msg: Telemetry switched off: an Enterprise Free or Trial cluster is throttled after 7 days without sending telemetry
fix: delete the statement; YugabyteDB has no telemetry-for-licence rule

msg: SET CLUSTER SETTING is CockroachDB-only SQL
fix: move the setting to yb-master / yb-tserver flags

msg: UPSERT INTO does not exist in YSQL
fix: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (pk) DO UPDATE SET col = EXCLUDED.col

msg: unique_rowid() is a CockroachDB built-in; YSQL has no such function
fix: BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, or a sequence

msg: STRING is a CockroachDB type alias; YSQL has no STRING type
fix: TEXT (or VARCHAR(n))

msg: BYTES is a CockroachDB type alias; YSQL has no BYTES type
fix: BYTEA

msg: INT is 64-bit in CockroachDB but 32-bit in YSQL: values above 2,147,483,647 overflow after the move
fix: BIGINT (or INT8)

msg: CockroachDB SERIAL defaults to a 64-bit unique_rowid() value; YSQL SERIAL is a 32-bit sequence
fix: BIGSERIAL or BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY

msg: Hash-sharded index syntax (USING HASH after the column list, bucket_count) is CockroachDB-only
fix: declare the hash column in the key: PRIMARY KEY (id HASH)

msg: Column families (FAMILY) are CockroachDB-only
fix: drop the FAMILY clauses

msg: INDEX inside CREATE TABLE is CockroachDB syntax; YSQL rejects it
fix: a separate CREATE INDEX ... ON table (cols) statement

msg: INVERTED INDEX is CockroachDB syntax
fix: CREATE INDEX ... USING GIN (col)

msg: STORING (...) is CockroachDB syntax for covering columns
fix: INCLUDE (...)

msg: AS OF SYSTEM TIME is CockroachDB-only
fix: drop the clause; use follower reads settings on the YSQL session

msg: CONFIGURE ZONE replica rules are CockroachDB-only
fix: CREATE TABLESPACE ... WITH (replica_placement = '...')

msg: Multi-region SQL (LOCALITY, PRIMARY REGION, SURVIVE) is CockroachDB-only
fix: tablespaces with replica_placement per region

msg: CHANGEFEED is CockroachDB-only
fix: a YugabyteDB CDC stream, set up outside the schema file

msg: crdb_internal is a CockroachDB system schema
fix: pg_catalog or information_schema

msg: ALTER ... SPLIT AT / SCATTER is CockroachDB range management
fix: CREATE TABLE ... SPLIT INTO n TABLETS

msg: IMPORT / BACKUP / RESTORE are CockroachDB statements
fix: COPY ... FROM, ysql_dump, or yb-voyager

msg: ALTER PRIMARY KEY is CockroachDB-only
fix: recreate the table with the new key and copy the rows

msg: Column ON UPDATE expressions are CockroachDB-only
fix: a BEFORE UPDATE trigger

msg: VIRTUAL computed columns are not in YSQL
fix: GENERATED ALWAYS AS (...) STORED, or a view
